outcome: incidence of Category II fetal heart rate tracings
cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women who accepted epidural analgesia during labor and had a body temperature exceeding 38 degC.
finding: Low-flow and short-term oxygen inhalation for parturients with epidural-related maternal fever reduced the incidence of Category II fetal heart rate tracings compared to cooling treatment.
mod_finding: Oxygen inhalation therapy had no significant influence on the mode of delivery (cesarean section rate, forceps delivery rate).
